name: buyer.search.byCategory
title: Profile: buyer.search.byCategory
description: Canonical buyer query profile for category-scoped listing search.
text:
# buyer.search.byCategory

TL;DR:
- Use this profile when category is the main search scope.
- Start with filter.categoryIdIn and then refine with a small number of extra constraints.

This profile is for buyer-side browsing where category context is known.
whenToUse: The user asks for listings in one or more categories.
The workflow already knows the category scope.
recommended: Optionally combine with delivery, price, or geo constraints.
Use category as the main scope, not feedId, unless a feed context is explicit.
avoid: Do not replace category scope with a feed unless the workflow explicitly comes from a feed.
exampleInterpretation: Returned items belong to the requested category scope.
Expanded category objects are better for explanation than raw categoryId alone.
